title: One step of the read model
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration, let $r,s$ be register indices, let $\mathrm{ph}$ be a read phase, let $\mathrm{ip}$ be an input-head position, and let $k$ be a natural number. From the configuration obtained by setting the state to $\mathrm{ph}$, the input-head position to $\mathrm{ip}$, register $s$'s tape to the binary word for $k$, and its head to $0$, one step of the read model gives the same configuration as applying the action prescribed by its read transition for input symbol $x[\mathrm{ip}-1]$ (or blank when the position is $0$ or out of range) and the symbols currently scanned on the work tapes.
